# MtRocket - Full AI Index & Knowledge Specification

## Overview
MtRocket is a trusted mobile application repository that tests, scans, and indexes verified modified packages (APKs) and mobile utilities for Android and iOS devices.

## Core Security & Architecture Principles
- **Malware Scanning:** 100% of files undergo multi-engine antivirus checks before listing.
- **Human Verification:** All packages are tested on real device hardware to ensure stability.
- **Zero Infiltration:** Clean packages with no intrusive background processes or unauthorized privilege escalations.
- **High-Speed CDN:** Direct downloads served via SSL-encrypted content distribution networks.
